summary: Looks up a filename in a packed resource table and seeks to its data entry. Copies the caller filename into a local buffer, strips any directory path up to the last backslash (character 92), normalizes the name via sub_589901, then linearly scans the 256-byte table entries (starting at this[74], name at entry+20) for a strcmp match. On success stores the found entry index at this[73] and calls sub_587F64 to seek the file handle this[4] to the entry's data offset. Returns 0 on success and -2 when the table is empty or no entry matches.

operations.description: Copy the input filename into the local buffer SrcStr with strcpy.
When CRTStrrchr(a2, 92) finds a backslash, shift the basename after the last separator over the buffer, replacing the directory prefix.
Normalize the trimmed name in SrcStr with sub_589901 (case/format conversion of the searched name).
Read the entry count from this[70]; return -2 when it is not greater than zero.
Scan the resource table starting at this[74] in 256-byte steps, comparing SrcStr against each entry name at entry+20 with strcmp; return -2 when the scan index reaches the entry count.
Store the matched entry index at this[73].
Seek the file handle this[4] to the entry data offset this[71] + *(entry+4) via sub_587F64 with a zero third argument.
Return 0 on a successful lookup and seek.
